---
title: "Tidyverse"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false

options(tidyverse.quiet = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

hex_address <-
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/refs/heads/main/SVG/"

cheatsheets_address <- "https://github.com/rstudio/cheatsheets/blob/main/"
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

make_table <- function(table) {
  table |> 
    select(-package) |> 
    gt() |> 
    tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE) |> 
    text_transform(
      locations = cells_body(columns = "Hex Sticker"),
      fn = \(x) web_image(url = x, height = 70)
    ) |>
    text_transform(
      locations = cells_body(columns = "URL"),
      fn = function(x) {
        map2_chr(x, table$package, \(x, pkg) {
          html(str_glue("<a href='{x}' target='_blank'>{pkg}</a>"))
        }
        )
      }
    ) |>
    text_transform(
      locations = cells_body(columns = "Cheatsheets"),
      fn = function(x) {
        map_chr(x, \(x) {
          if (is.na(x)) {
            ""
          } else{
            html(str_glue("<a href='{x}' target='_blank'>cheatsheet</a>"))
          }
        }
        )
      }
    )
}
```

## Meta Package

```{r}
#| echo: false

tibble(
  package = "tidyverse",
  "Hex Sticker" = str_glue("{hex_address}{package}.svg"),
  "URL" = str_glue("https://{package}.tidyverse.org"),
  "Cheatsheets" = NA
) |>
  make_table()
```

## Core

```{r}
#| echo: false

core <- c("dplyr", "forcats", "ggplot2", "lubridate", "purrr",
          "readr", "stringr", "tibble", "tidyr")

cheatsheets <- c("data-transformation", "factors", "data-visualization",
                 "lubridate", "purrr", "data-import", "strings", NA, "tidyr")

tibble(
  package = core,
  "Hex Sticker" = str_glue("{hex_address}{package}.svg"),
  "URL" = str_glue("https://{package}.tidyverse.org"),
  "Cheatsheets" = if_else(is.na(cheatsheets), NA_character_,
                          str_glue("{cheatsheets_address}{cheatsheets}.pdf"))
) |> 
  make_table()
```

## Program

```{r}
#| echo: false

tibble(
  package = c("glue", "magrittr"),
  hex = c("glue", "pipe"),
  "Hex Sticker" = str_glue("{hex_address}{hex}.svg"),
  "URL" = str_glue("https://{package}.tidyverse.org"),
  "Cheatsheets" = NA
) |> 
  select(-hex) |> 
  make_table()
```

## Import

```{r}
#| echo: false

packages <- c("googledrive", "googlesheets4", "haven",
              "readxl", "rvest", "vroom")

hex <- str_glue("{hex_address}{packages}.svg")
hex[[6]] <- NA

tibble(
  package = packages,
  "Hex Sticker" = hex,
  "URL" = hex_address,
  "Cheatsheets" = NA
) |>
  make_table()
```
